verdict.rationale: Dagster's evidence covers orchestration, scheduling, and ingestion/ELT integrations (Airbyte, Fivetran, dlt, dbt) but nothing about syncing modeled data back into CRM/ads/support SaaS tools (e.g., reverse-ETL connectors like Census/Hightouch, Salesforce, HubSpot, ad platforms). As a general-purpose orchestrator this axis is plausible, but no evidence shows a shipped capability for reverse-ETL activation specifically.
